name: cert-verify-cronjob-failures
description: Count failures from the in-cluster TLS certificate verification CronJob (cert-verify-prod).
filter: resource.type="k8s_container" AND resource.labels.namespace_name="mereka-lms" AND resource.labels.container_name="cert-verify" AND resource.labels.pod_name=~"^cert-verify-prod-" AND (textPayload:"FAILED (" OR textPayload:"fake ingress certificate" OR textPayload:"SAN missing" OR jsonPayload.message:"FAILED (")
